title: Python & DSA Mastery Roadmap
subtitle: Complete English Curriculum from Modern Python Internals to LeetCode Data Structures & Algorithms

stages.title: Python Modern Syntax & Language Internals
stages.subtitle: Memory Model, OOP, Generators, Iterators & Decorators in Python
stages.description: Master core Python engineering rigor for algorithmic problem solving. Understand Python's reference model, memory management, OOP dunder methods, generator streaming pipelines, iterator protocols, and memoization decorators.
learningOutcomes: Master Python data model: mutability, identity (is vs ==), and garbage collection
Author clean OOP classes using dunder methods (__init__, __repr__, __eq__, __lt__) for custom heap/sort order
Implement memory-efficient streaming algorithms using generators and yield
Apply decorators and functools.lru_cache for automated top-down DP memoization

modules.title: Python Foundation & Language Model
modules.summary: Modern Python 3 syntax, type hints, reference semantics, and control structures.

videos.title: Learn Python - Full Course for Beginners [English Tutorial]
keyTakeaways: Python syntax, dynamic typing, and fundamental control flow
Functions, scope, error handling with try/except, and file I/O
Standard library foundation and Python idioms (PEP 8)

videos.title: Python OOP - Working with Classes, Instances & Dunder Methods
keyTakeaways: Class vs instance variables and self parameter semantics
Overriding __eq__, __hash__, and __lt__ for comparator logic in DSA
Inheritance, encapsulation, and property decorators

modules.title: Generators, Iterators & Performance Protocols
modules.summary: Memory optimization using generator expressions, custom iterables, and caching decorators.

videos.title: Python Generators: Memory Optimization & Stream Processing
keyTakeaways: Lazy evaluation with yield vs eager list materialization in memory
Chaining generator pipelines for processing massive streams
Measuring memory footprints using sys.getsizeof

videos.title: Python Iterators & Iterables: Custom Protocols Under the Hood
keyTakeaways: Differentiating iterables from iterators via __iter__ and __next__
Building custom range/traversal iterators for custom graph structures
StopIteration protocol and Python's internal for-loop mechanism

videos.title: Python Decorators & Memoization with functools.lru_cache
keyTakeaways: Higher-order functions and closure variable binding
Writing caching decorators to prevent redundant recursion calls
Leveraging @functools.lru_cache(None) for instantaneous DP optimization

stages.title: Algorithmic Complexity & Python Built-in Containers
stages.subtitle: Big-O, Dynamic Arrays, Hash Tables & Collections Module
stages.description: Understand time and space complexity in Python. Master dynamic array resizing, hash table amortized O(1) lookups, collision resolution, and the collections module (Counter, deque, defaultdict).
learningOutcomes: Analyze Big-O time and space complexity for recursive and iterative Python code
Understand dynamic array memory allocation, doubling strategy, and amortized complexity
Harness collections.defaultdict, collections.Counter, and collections.deque for O(1) operations
Benchmark algorithmic execution speed using timeit and cProfile

modules.title: Complexity Analysis & Asymptotic Bounds
modules.summary: Big-O notation, space complexity, call stack frames, and operation limits.

videos.title: Big-O Notation & Complexity Analysis for Coding Interviews
keyTakeaways: Asymptotic upper bound (Big-O), lower bound, and tight bounds
Common complexities: O(1), O(log n), O(n), O(n log n), O(2^n), O(n!)
Evaluating Python list and dict operations under the hood

videos.title: Data Structures & Algorithms in Python - Big-O to Arrays
keyTakeaways: Linear search vs binary search complexity and execution trade-offs
Memory representations of contiguous arrays in Python runtime
Benchmarking algorithm scalability against large input sizes

modules.title: Python Collections & Array Internals
modules.summary: Deep dive into dict, set, deque, Counter, and dynamic array resizing.

videos.title: Python Collections Module: Counter, deque & defaultdict Mastery
keyTakeaways: collections.defaultdict to avoid KeyError in frequency counting
collections.Counter for anagram and frequency comparison in O(n)
collections.deque for true O(1) double-ended queue operations

videos.title: Dynamic Arrays - Resizing, Amortized O(1) Push & Python Lists
keyTakeaways: Internal capacity vs length in dynamic array resizing
Amortized cost proof for array doubling strategy
Implementing a custom ResizableArray class in Python

stages.title: Two Pointers, Sliding Window & Binary Search
stages.subtitle: Essential Linear Array Search & Pointer Traversal Patterns
stages.description: Master the foundational patterns that solve 40%+ of array interview problems: opposite directional two pointers, fast & slow pointers, fixed/variable sliding windows, and binary search on values and arrays.
learningOutcomes: Implement inward and forward two-pointer traversal patterns in O(n) time
Apply variable sliding windows with hash map frequency state tracking
Master binary search template for exact match, lower bound, and upper bound
Solve binary search on answer/solution space problems (Koko Eating Bananas)

modules.title: Two Pointers & Binary Search
modules.summary: Opposite directional pointer convergence and logarithmic space partitioning.

videos.title: Binary Search - Recursive & Iterative in Python (LeetCode 704)
keyTakeaways: Midpoint calculation avoiding integer overflow (mid = left + (right-left)//2)
Loop invariants: left <= right vs left < right boundary conditions
Logarithmic O(log n) time complexity proof

videos.title: Two Pointers Technique - Valid Palindrome & Container With Most Water
keyTakeaways: Greedy height elimination in Container With Most Water (O(n) time)
Handling non-alphanumeric filtering with str.isalnum()
Three-sum sorting and deduplication logic

modules.title: Sliding Window & Solution Space Search
modules.summary: Variable window expansion/contraction and monotone predicate search.

videos.title: Sliding Window Technique - Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
keyTakeaways: Window invariant maintenance: expanding right and shrinking left
Using a set or dictionary to track character occurrences in O(1)
Minimum Window Substring frequency matching condition

videos.title: Binary Search on Search Space - Koko Eating Bananas (LeetCode 875)
keyTakeaways: Identifying monotonic feasibility predicate f(speed) -> bool
Setting search boundaries between min possible and max possible answers
Ceiling division arithmetic in Python: (pile + speed - 1) // speed

stages.title: Linear Data Structures: Linked Lists, Stacks & Queues
stages.subtitle: Node Pointer Manipulation, Floyd's Cycle Detection & Monotonic Stacks
stages.description: Deep dive into node-based linear data structures. Master in-place pointer manipulation, doubly linked lists for LRU Cache design, Floyd's cycle detection, and monotonic stacks for Next Greater Element problems.
learningOutcomes: Implement singly and doubly linked lists with dummy head nodes
Detect cycles and cycle entry points with Floyd's Tortoise and Hare algorithm
Architect an O(1) LRU Cache using a hash map combined with a doubly linked list
Utilize monotonic decreasing and increasing stacks for histogram and temperature problems

modules.title: Linked Lists & Cycle Detection
modules.summary: Pointer rewiring, reversal, and two-pointer cycle detection.

videos.title: Singly Linked Lists - Implementation & Reversal in Python
keyTakeaways: Defining ListNode class in Python with val and next attributes
In-place iterative reversal using prev, curr, and nxt pointers
Recursive reversal mental model and stack frame rollback

videos.title: Doubly Linked Lists & LRU Cache Architecture (LeetCode 146)
keyTakeaways: Dummy head and dummy tail sentinel nodes to eliminate edge cases
Pairing dict[key, Node] with doubly linked list for O(1) get and put
Atomic node removal and insertion at most recent position

videos.title: Fast & Slow Pointers: Floyd's Tortoise and Hare Cycle Detection
keyTakeaways: Mathematical proof of convergence when slow moves 1 step and fast moves 2
Finding cycle entrance point: resetting one pointer to head
Detecting cycles in arrays: Find the Duplicate Number (LeetCode 287)

modules.title: Stacks, Queues & Monotonic Sequences
modules.summary: LIFO/FIFO paradigms and monotonic stack pruning.

videos.title: Stacks & Queues with collections.deque in Python
keyTakeaways: Why Python list pop(0) is O(n) while deque popleft() is O(1)
Valid Parentheses problem with hash map bracket matching
Evaluating Reverse Polish Notation using stack operand evaluation

videos.title: Monotonic Stack Pattern - Daily Temperatures & Next Greater Element
keyTakeaways: Maintaining strict monotonicity (decreasing stack to find next greater)
Storing (index, value) tuples on stack to resolve distances in O(n)
Largest Rectangle in Histogram monotonic boundary analysis

stages.title: Non-Linear Structures: Trees, BSTs & Heap/Priority Queues
stages.subtitle: Tree Traversals, BST Validation, Lowest Common Ancestor & heapq
stages.description: Master hierarchical non-linear structures. Implement recursive DFS and iterative BFS tree traversals, validate BST properties, solve Lowest Common Ancestor, and harness Python's heapq for streaming Top-K problems.
learningOutcomes: Implement Preorder, Inorder, Postorder, and Level-Order traversals in Python
Validate Binary Search Trees using recursive (min_val, max_val) bounds
Determine Lowest Common Ancestor in binary trees and BSTs
Utilize Python's heapq module for min-heaps, max-heaps, and Top-K streaming elements

modules.title: Binary Trees & BSTs
modules.summary: DFS recursion, BFS queue traversals, and BST invariants.

videos.title: Binary Tree Traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder, Level Order)
keyTakeaways: Recursive depth-first traversal patterns (DFS)
Iterative breadth-first traversal (BFS) using collections.deque
Maximum depth and diameter of binary tree calculations

videos.title: Binary Search Tree: Search, Insert, and Validate BST Invariants
keyTakeaways: BST property: all left subtree keys < root < all right subtree keys
Validating BST using (low, high) float('-inf') / float('inf') boundaries
Inorder traversal of BST yields strictly sorted order

videos.title: Lowest Common Ancestor in Binary Trees & BSTs (LeetCode 235 & 236)
keyTakeaways: Exploiting BST directional divergence (p.val < root.val < q.val)
General binary tree postorder bottom-up bubbling of matched nodes
O(h) time complexity where h is tree height

modules.title: Heaps & Priority Queues
modules.summary: heapq module, min/max heap semantics, and Top-K frequency tracking.

videos.title: Heaps & Priority Queues in Python using heapq Module
keyTakeaways: Python heapq creates min-heaps by default; negate values for max-heaps
heapify() converts list in O(n) linear time
heappush() and heappop() operate in O(log n) time

videos.title: Top-K Frequent Elements & Kth Largest Element with Heaps
keyTakeaways: Maintaining a min-heap of size K for optimal O(n log k) complexity
Bucket sort alternative for O(n) linear time Top-K frequency
Find Median from Data Stream using two balancing heaps

stages.title: Recursion, Backtracking & Prefix Trees (Tries)
stages.subtitle: State Space Trees, Combinatorial Search, Pruning & Trie Autocomplete
stages.description: Unlock combinatorial search and prefix tree architectures. Build mental models for state space recursion trees, master backtracking decision pruning (Subsets, Combinations, N-Queens), and implement high-throughput Trie prefix trees.
learningOutcomes: Construct recursive state trees with explicit base cases and backtracking state undoing
Prune invalid recursive search branches early to reduce exponential time complexity
Implement Trie (Prefix Tree) with insert, search, and startsWith methods in Python
Solve Word Search II combining Trie indexing with 2D grid backtracking

modules.title: Backtracking & Decision Trees
modules.summary: Combinations, subsets, permutations, and search pruning.

videos.title: Recursion Tree Mental Model & Call Stack Execution in Python
keyTakeaways: Visualizing recursive call frames and return values on the call stack
Avoiding maximum recursion depth exceeded with sys.setrecursionlimit
Distinguishing divide-and-conquer from exhaustive search

videos.title: Backtracking Patterns: Subsets & Combinations in Python (LeetCode 78)
keyTakeaways: Pick or don't pick binary decision tree pattern
State mutation: subset.append(nums[i]), recurse, subset.pop()
Time complexity: O(2^n) subsets generating 2^n possibilities

videos.title: Permutations & Combination Sum with State Pruning (LeetCode 39 & 46)
keyTakeaways: Pruning search branches when remaining target < 0
Handling duplicate elements with sorting and sibling check
Generating permutations using element inclusion bitmasks or visited sets

videos.title: Word Search & 2D Grid Backtracking (LeetCode 79)
keyTakeaways: Directional delta vectors: dr, dc = [-1, 1, 0, 0], [0, 0, -1, 1]
Temporarily marking visited cells in-place to save O(r*c) space
Early termination when grid cell character doesn't match word[index]

modules.title: Prefix Trees (Tries)
modules.summary: TrieNode class, character hashing, and prefix searching.

videos.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree) - LeetCode 208 in Python
keyTakeaways: TrieNode architecture: children dict/array and is_end_of_word boolean
O(L) time complexity for word insertion and prefix lookups
Implementing wildcard '.' search in WordDictionary (LeetCode 211)

stages.title: Graphs: BFS, DFS, Shortest Paths & Disjoint Set Union
stages.subtitle: Adjacency Lists, Topological Sort, Dijkstra & Union-Find in Python
stages.description: Master network algorithms and relational graph problems. Build adjacency lists with defaultdict, compute shortest paths via BFS, detect cycles and topological order via Kahn's algorithm, implement Dijkstra's algorithm with heapq, and master Disjoint Set Union (DSU).
learningOutcomes: Represent directed and undirected graphs in Python using defaultdict(list)
Execute BFS for shortest path in unweighted graphs and DFS for connected components
Implement Kahn's topological sort algorithm to detect deadlocks and compile orders
Apply Dijkstra's algorithm with min-heaps for single-source shortest path problems
Build Disjoint Set Union (DSU) with path compression and rank optimization

modules.title: Graph Representations & Traversals
modules.summary: Adjacency lists, BFS shortest paths, and DFS cycle detection.

videos.title: Graph Representations in Python: Adjacency List using defaultdict
keyTakeaways: Adjacency list vs adjacency matrix space and time tradeoffs
Constructing graphs from raw edge lists with collections.defaultdict
Handling directed, undirected, and weighted graph edges

videos.title: Breadth First Search (BFS) for Shortest Path in Unweighted Graphs
keyTakeaways: Level-order queue expansion guaranteeing shortest unweighted path
Tracking visited set immediately upon enqueueing to prevent duplicates
Multi-source BFS pattern: Rotting Oranges (LeetCode 994)

videos.title: Depth First Search (DFS) & Connected Components (Number of Islands)
keyTakeaways: Grid graph exploration: row, col boundary checks and visited marking
Counting connected components by triggering DFS on unvisited land cells
Clone Graph: deep copy with hash map mapping original to clone nodes

modules.title: Topological Sort, Dijkstra & Union-Find
modules.summary: DAG scheduling, weighted shortest paths, and disjoint set partitioning.

videos.title: Topological Sort & Kahn's Algorithm - Course Schedule (LeetCode 207)
keyTakeaways: In-degree array initialization and zero-in-degree queue processing
Detecting cycles: if processed node count < total nodes, cycle exists
Course Schedule II: generating exact topological prerequisite order

videos.title: Dijkstra's Algorithm with Min-Heap heapq (Network Delay Time)
keyTakeaways: Min-heap holding (distance, node) pairs for greedy nearest node selection
Skipping outdated heap entries when dist > shortest_path[node]
O((V + E) log V) time complexity proof

videos.title: Union-Find (Disjoint Set Union) with Path Compression & Rank (LeetCode 684)
keyTakeaways: Parent pointer array and rank/size array initialization
find(x) with path compression flattening the tree to O(alpha(n)) ~ O(1)
union(x, y) returning False when nodes already belong to same component

stages.title: Dynamic Programming & Greedy Algorithms in Python
stages.subtitle: 1D/2D DP, Knapsack, Longest Common Subsequence & Greedy Intervals
stages.description: Conquer the pinnacle of algorithmic problem solving: Dynamic Programming and Greedy Optimization. Move systematically from recursion + memoization to bottom-up tabulation with space optimization. Master 1D, 2D grid DP, 0/1 knapsack, intervals, and bit manipulation tricks.
learningOutcomes: Deconstruct DP problems into states, transition relations, and base cases
Transition top-down memoization (@lru_cache) into space-optimized bottom-up 1D arrays
Solve classical DP patterns: House Robber, Coin Change, LIS, LCS, and 0/1 Knapsack
Execute greedy choices for interval scheduling and jump game reachability
Utilize bit manipulation bitmasks for subset and set state representation

modules.title: 1D Dynamic Programming
modules.summary: Memoization, tabulation, and state variable compression.

videos.title: 1D Dynamic Programming: Climbing Stairs & House Robber in Python
keyTakeaways: Identifying subproblems: dp[i] = dp[i-1] + dp[i-2]
Reducing O(n) array space to O(1) two variables (prev1, prev2)
House Robber: deciding between robbing current house vs skipping

videos.title: Coin Change & Unbounded Knapsack Memoization (LeetCode 322)
keyTakeaways: dp[amount] = min(dp[amount - coin] + 1 for coin in coins)
Initializing table with float('inf') and base case dp[0] = 0
Handling impossible configurations gracefully returning -1

videos.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS) with DP & Binary Search (LeetCode 300)
keyTakeaways: Standard O(n^2) nested loop bottom-up tabulation approach
Patience sorting with bisect.bisect_left for O(n log n) optimal runtime
Reconstructing the actual sequence using predecessor pointers

modules.title: 2D Dynamic Programming & Knapsack
modules.summary: Grid DP, subsequence matching, and 0/1 knapsack transformations.

videos.title: 2D Dynamic Programming: Unique Paths & Min Path Sum (LeetCode 62 & 64)
keyTakeaways: Transition: dp[r][c] = dp[r-1][c] + dp[r][c-1]
Compressing 2D grid matrix into a single 1D rolling row array
Handling obstacle grids by zeroing out unreachable cells

videos.title: 0/1 Knapsack Problem: Space-Optimized Tabulation in Python
keyTakeaways: Choice matrix: take item (remaining weight decreases) or skip item
Reverse iteration on weight to prevent using same item multiple times in 1D array
Partition Equal Subset Sum (LeetCode 416) mapped to target = sum//2

videos.title: Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) Grid DP (LeetCode 1143)
keyTakeaways: Character match: dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i-1][j-1]
Mismatch: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
Applications: Edit Distance (Levenshtein), diff tools, DNA sequence alignment

modules.title: Greedy Algorithms, Intervals & Bit Manipulation
modules.summary: Locally optimal choice, interval merging, and bitwise tricks.

videos.title: Greedy Algorithms: Jump Game & Gas Station (LeetCode 55 & 134)
keyTakeaways: Greedy goal post shifting: working backwards from last index
Single pass O(n) reachability vs O(n^2) dynamic programming
Gas Station: running balance tracking and starting index determination

videos.title: Merge Intervals & Meeting Rooms Pattern (LeetCode 56 & 253)
keyTakeaways: Sorting intervals by start time: intervals.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
Merging overlapping ranges: if curr.start <= prev.end: prev.end = max(prev.end, curr.end)
Min-heap approach for Meeting Rooms II counting concurrent rooms

videos.title: Bit Manipulation Tricks in Python: XOR, Bitmasks, Power of Two (LeetCode 136)
keyTakeaways: XOR properties: a ^ a = 0 and a ^ 0 = a for Single Number in O(1) space
Brian Kernighan's algorithm (n & (n - 1)) to count set bits in O(k)
Bitmask state representation for traveling salesman and subset enumeration
